en: Black‑and‑white view of a cobblestoned town square bordered by 18th–19th‑century two‑storey buildings with steep tiled roofs. In the foreground are several 1930s–1940s style cars parked near a kiosk. A main street runs along the right side where pedestrians walk by shops. A road sign on a pole points toward another locality. The central building at the far side of the square has a slightly grander façade with decorative gables, suggesting a town hall or similar civic building.
